observations.body: Paul describes departure, completed course, and awaiting crown. For I am already being offered, and the time of my departure has come. From now on, the crown of righteousness is stored up for me, which the Lord, the righteous judge, will give to me on that day; and not to me only, but also to all those who have loved his appearing.
